steps.title: Bem-vindo: Listening - Volume 9
steps.text: In this A1-level lesson, we'll explore essential vocabulary and phrases about "Listening". Get ready to level up your real-world communication skills!

words.example: I listen to a podcast during my commute.
Sorry, could you slow down a little?
Sorry, could you repeat that a bit slower?

steps.text: It means: "To face a difficult situation with courage.". Say the example sentence out loud:
steps.targetPhrase: I hate going to the dentist, but I'll just have to bite the bullet.
